items.prompt:
The job a sentence does within a passage is its:
A) function
B) spelling
C) margin

Why the author wrote the passage is its:
A) purpose
B) page count
C) title font

A sentence that begins 'For example' serves to:
A) give an example
B) end the passage
C) change the topic

Read.

(1) Many believe bats are blind. (2) In fact, most bats see well. (3) They rely on echolocation in the dark.

The function of sentence (2) is to:
A) correct the misconception in sentence (1)
B) repeat sentence (1)
C) change the subject
items.answer: A) correct the misconception in sentence (1)

solution.answer: A) correct the misconception in sentence (1)

items.prompt:
What is the overall PURPOSE of that passage?
A) to correct a common misconception about bats' eyesight
B) to sell bat houses
C) to tell a joke
items.answer: A) to correct a common misconception about bats' eyesight

steps: Sets up, then corrects. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to correct a common misconception about bats' eyesight

items.prompt:
A sentence beginning 'However' most likely serves to:
A) signal a contrast or shift
B) give a statistic
C) restate the title
items.answer: A) signal a contrast or shift

solution.answer: A) signal a contrast or shift

items.prompt:
Read.

(1) Electric cars are often called emission-free. (2) Yet the electricity that charges them may come from coal plants. (3) Their true emissions therefore depend on the power source.

The function of sentence (3) is to:
A) draw the logical conclusion from (1) and (2)
B) restate sentence (1)
C) introduce a new topic
items.answer: A) draw the logical conclusion from (1) and (2)

solution.answer: A) draw the logical conclusion from (1) and (2)
